newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ALPHA BANK TO CUT DEPO, LOAN RATES MAY 19.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ALPHA BANK TO CUT DEPO, LOAN RATES MAY 19.

text.p: Greece's Alpha Credit Bank, the country's largest private bank, will slash its prime rate by 225 basis points to 12.50 percent and its base deposit rate by 100 basis points to 8.50 percent effective May 19, it said.

"Following the increase of the equity capital by 72.6 billion drachmas and the favourable macroeconomic conditions, Alpha Credit Bank proceeds with a new, significant rate reduction," it said in a statement.
